assessments.reasoning: N3220 §5.1.2.3.1 paragraph 1 on printed page 13 (PDF page 26) directly makes a hosted environment optional. Its second clause requires a provided hosted environment to conform to the specifications that follow in the hosted section. The exact bytes were retrieved from WG14's document directory and the PDF identifies itself as working draft N3220. The independently computed SHA-256 equals the registered digest.

challenge.method: Test the two readings that every implementation must provide a hosted environment or that the rules of a provided hosted environment are optional. Check which part of the sentence the condition governs.
challenge.results: The first clause makes provision optional. The second imposes conformance conditionally on presence. The placement under Hosted environment limits the rule to that environment in N3220.

limitations: This result addresses the condition in the specified working draft. It does not establish particular requirements for freestanding environments or the published edition.
